title: Python Technical Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Python Technical Manager with expertise in Django and Django Rest Framework (DRF) to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building high-performance web applications and scalable backend services while working in a collaborative, agile environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using Python, Django, and Django Rest Framework (DRF).

Build RESTful APIs to support front-end and third-party integrations.

Collaborate with the front-end development team for seamless integration of user interfaces.

Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and security.

Debug, troubleshoot, and improve application performance.

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following coding standards.

Ensure data security and compliance with privacy regulations.

Implement automated testing and conduct code reviews to maintain code quality.

Stay updated with the latest trends in backend development and share knowledge with the team.

**Required Qualifications:**

Experience: Minimum 5-10 years of hands-on experience in Python development with expertise in Django and DRF.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Technical Skills:**

Strong command of Python programming.

Deep understanding of the Django web framework and Django Rest Framework (DRF).

Experience in building RESTful APIs.

Familiarity with relational databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, and ORM (Object Relational Mapper).

Hands-on experience with version control systems like Git.

Knowledge of Docker, Celery, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Experience with asynchronous programming and task scheduling tools.

Exposure to front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML, CSS) is a plus.

Understanding of software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies.

**Soft Skills:**

Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.

Strong communication and collaboration abilities.

Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

Self-motivated with a proactive attitude toward learning and implementing new technologies.

**Preferred Skills (Good to Have):**

Experience in a product-based industry or the healthcare domain.

Familiarity with microservices architecture and modern CI/CD pipelines.

Knowledge of authentication mechanisms, API gateways, or third-party integrations.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your CTC & ECTC ?
* What is your notice period ?
* What is your preferred location- Bangalore/Coimbatore/Hyderabad ?

Experience:

* Total: 10 years (Required)
* Python: 7 years (Required)
* Django: 6 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

title: Product Manager
description:
Kovai.co is a global B2B SaaS product company building enterprise software from India for businesses worldwide. Over the years, we've grown rapidly and profitably, and today we're on track towards $30 million in annual revenue - with an even bigger journey ahead.

Trusted by customers across 100+ countries, including Fortune 500 enterprises and fast-scaling startups, we build products that solve complex, mission-critical problems at scale.

At the heart of Kovai.co is a tribe of thoughtful helpers - people passionate about empowering customers, uplifting colleagues, and continuously growing in our own journeys.

**What we build:**

* BizTalk360: Our first product, built to help enterprises simplify and manage complex integration environments with confidence - trusted by Microsoft, Mercedes-Benz, Pfizer, Vodafone, BBC, and NBCUniversal.
* Turbo360: Our fast-growing Azure Cloud Management and FinOps platform, helping enterprises gain visibility, optimize cloud costs, and run smarter, more efficient cloud operations at scale.
* Document360: Our flagship AI-powered knowledge management platform, helping teams create, manage, and deliver exceptional documentation experiences - trusted by companies like Puma, HP, VMware, McDonald's, and Virgin Group.

Three products > One cultures of innovation, ownership, and customer obsession.

**How we work:**

We believe great work happens when talented people are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best. At Kovai.co, our teams are collaborative, ownership-driven, and deeply invested in craftsmanship, continuous learning, and open communication - creating an environment where people grow together, contribute meaningfully, and build strong relationships alongside impactful outcomes.

At Kovai.co, AI isn't just a capability - it's our superpower. We embrace AI-first thinking to help our teams work smarter, solve problems creatively, and create greater impact for our customers and each other.  
  
**What's the Job: Product Manager**

**What You'll Do on the Job**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for our SaaS product, from product discovery and planning to development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Define product strategy, roadmaps, and feature priorities based on business objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities.
* Create use cases, user stories, and detailed product requirements that clearly articulate product functionality and expected outcomes.
* Identify, prioritise, and deliver product improvements to enhance usability, customer experience, and overall product value.
* Drive product definition and execution, leveraging AI tools where relevant for product research, requirement documentation, analysis, and prototyping.
* Work cross-functionally with design and technology teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery of product features and enhancements, while exploring opportunities to improve product workflows through AI.

**Who'll Be a Good Fit**

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Product Management or Software Implementation.
* Strong understanding of software engineering concepts, along with practical experience in product management.
* Experience managing a product throughout its lifecycle, from ideation and requirement gathering to development and launch.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with data, build models, and derive actionable insights.
* Experience with product analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar platforms.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, ownership, and hands-on execution capabilities, with an openness to adopting AI tools to improve productivity and decision-making.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate business problems and translate them into clear product requirements and solutions.
* Work experience in SaaS is preferred.
* Experience with Scrum/Agile development processes and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Equal Opportunities:**

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe that great talent thrives in an environment built on fairness, belonging, and equal opportunity for all.

title: Virtual Relationship Manager
description:

Candidates who successfully complete the internship will be moved to the Trainee position with a monthly stipend until completion of their final examinations. Upon successful completion of the examinations and satisfactory performance, eligible candidates may be converted to full-time employment with MidFin Wealth Private Limited.

**Interested candidates can apply now!**

title: PPC Expert
description:
About Backdropsource

Backdropsource is a fast-growing global e-commerce brand delivering custom-printed backdrops and fabrics to customers across North America and Europe.

About the Role

We’re hiring for two positions, a Senior PPC Expert and a PPC Expert (Mid-Level), to run, optimize, and scale our paid acquisition engine. Both are hands-on roles: you’ll plan, run, and optimize campaigns end-to-end across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other platforms, with a direct line to revenue and ROAS, not just spend management.

Location: Coimbatore (in office)

Department: Performance Marketing

Compensation: Industry standard

Mandatory: Hands-on Shopify e-commerce experience. Bonus if you have B2B experience as well.

What We’re Looking For (both roles)

* 5+ years of hands-on PPC experience, including running paid campaigns for a Shopify e-commerce store

* Proven track record of managing significant ad spend profitably across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads

* Strong command of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads Editor, Shopify, Meta Business Suite, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including conversion tracking setups and offline conversion tracking

* Analytical, data-driven mindset, comfortable finding the “why” behind performance

* Understanding of e-commerce funnels and how paid media connects to revenue goals

* Ability to take a brand or product line from zero to one, building a paid strategy from the ground up

* Clear communicator who can explain performance and strategy to non-technical stakeholders

How the Two Roles Differ

Senior PPC Expert

* Has managed a team of PPC or performance marketers, or at minimum worked within a performance marketing team reporting to a lead

* Guides and mentors the PPC team: reviews campaign builds, shares best practices, and sets account standards

PPC Expert (Mid-Level)

* Hands-on optimizer who fully owns campaign performance: bids, budgets, search terms, audiences, and creatives

* Team management experience is not required

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, execute, and optimize PPC campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Bing Ads, and other channels for North America and Europe

* Own budget allocation and bidding strategy to hit ROAS / CPA / CAC targets

* Drive keyword research, audience segmentation, and ad copy and creative testing

* Run day-to-day optimization: search term reviews, negative keywords, bid and budget adjustments, and audience refinement

* Manage conversion tracking, pixels, and tagging (GA4, GTM, Shopify, Meta Pixel/CAPI, LinkedIn Insight Tag), including offline conversion tracking

* Partner with the design and content team on ad creatives and landing pages, and run structured A/B tests

* Identify and pilot new paid channels such as Microsoft Ads, Pinterest, and TikTok Ads

* Take paid strategy from zero to one for new product lines and markets

* Build and present performance reports and dashboards to leadership

* Stay ahead of platform updates, bidding algorithm changes, and industry best practices

Nice to Have

* B2B lead generation and marketing funnel experience

* Familiarity with Semrush, Microsoft Clarity, and similar attribution/analytics platforms

* Experience with email marketing and WhatsApp marketing tools

title: Analyst, Cluster Head- Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Cluster Business Ownership
* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.

* Sales Leadership and Channel Execution
* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

* Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up
* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

* Solution-Led Cross-Sell
* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.

* Customer Relationship and Service Governance
* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality
* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

* People Leadership
* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

Key Performance IndicatorsDimensionIllustrative KPIsAcquisitionNew-to-bank current accounts, high-value accounts, segment-wise acquisitionBalance GrowthAQB/AMB growth, activated accounts, value build-up and balance retentionTransaction PrimacyInward credits, transaction-active accounts and payment/collection volumesRevenueFee income, POS/QR revenue, cash-management revenue and cross-sell revenueProduct PenetrationInternet banking, POS, debit/business card, FFD, assets and promoter bankingPortfolio QualityNon-activation rate, dormant accounts, early attrition, balance decline and compliance exceptionsTeam PerformanceProductivity per RM, conversion rate, hiring quality, attrition and training completionCustomer ExperienceOnboarding TAT, service-resolution TAT, complaint trends and retention of top accounts

Regional Office Coimbatore

title: Officer, Branch Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
description:

**Job Purpose**

* To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance by acquiring and engaging with DBS clients having an AUM => INR 1 million through “need-based approach” and ensure client coverage and product penetration through cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage & maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through pro-active client engagement & relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service and Distribution and Product team

**Key Accountabilities**

* Acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch location areas to Treasures segment.
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth

* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.

Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.
